post.summary: Submit on-device pose detection feedback flags
post.description: HARD CONTRACT RULE: All ML Kit pose inference runs locally on the mobile client. Only structured geometric flags and issue summaries (e.g. knees_caving_in, lumbar_flexion) are submitted. Zero video files, camera frames, or image byte buffers ever leave the device.

post.summary: Generate tailored routine (Rules-based or Gemini AI with equipment photo vision)
post.description: Generates a balanced workout session targeting specified muscle groups, available gym equipment, target session duration, and fitness goals (hypertrophy, strength, endurance, general_fitness). Supports multimodal equipment photo vision input (up to 4 JPEG/PNG/WebP base64 images under 512KB each, aggregate 2MB ceiling). Transparently falls back to deterministic rule-based selection if AI quota is exhausted or vision calls encounter network interruptions.

items.description: Base64 data URL for JPEG, PNG, or WebP equipment photo

400.description: Invalid generation parameters or equipment image validation error

413.description: Payload too large: request body stream exceeded 4MB ceiling
